uninstall.title: Uninstall LastSave
uninstall.detail:
Your games, logs and screenshots are kept unless you delete them.
Deleting moves them to the Recycle Bin.

databaseTooNew.title: Update LastSave to open this library
databaseTooNew.message:
This library was last opened by a newer version of LastSave, and older versions cannot read it safely.

Install the latest version of LastSave and try again. Your data has not been changed.

(Library format {{databaseVersion}}; this version reads up to {{supportedVersion}}.)
